none: PAS NARC-5DA8F4: Early medieval coin: silver sceatta
contea di ritrovamento: Northamptonshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An early medieval Series D type 2c('continental runic') silver sceatta. This type developed out of early series C designs, from the late primary or intermediate phases,perhaps the latter, given that the silver appears rather debased.
